title: InfoGurus: The Digital Library of Alexandria
summary: A walkable agent-managed DAO campus set around Bibliotheca Alexandrina on Alexandria's Mediterranean shore. Six zones map the DAO workflow: charter, research, proposals, operations, and progress—all agents operate, humans govern.

buildings.name: Charter Rotunda
buildings.use: Public display of the DAO charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes

buildings.name: Contribution Ledger House
buildings.use: Records member contributions and outcome definitions

districts.real_anchor: مركز المؤتمرات بمكتبة الإسكندرية (BA Conference Center)

buildings.name: Proposal Colonnade
buildings.use: Open-air debate of agent-drafted proposals; human final vote

districts.real_anchor: مركز القبة السماوية العلمي (Planetarium Science Center)

buildings.name: Outcome Observatory
buildings.use: Tracks progress against the charter's measurable outcomes

court.name: The Stewards' Court of the Library
court.style: A sunken circular amphitheater beneath the library disc, echoing the ancient Mouseion
court.why_here: Site of the ancient Great Library: the fitting stage for human-only final votes and reserved governance powers.

quests.title: Charter by the Sea
steps: Read the etched charter tablet in Charter Hall
Record one measurable outcome with the ledger keeper
Trace the outcome to its milestone marker in the Observatory
Report the milestone to the Progress Tracker

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Collect three summarized evidence scrolls from the Evidence Annex
Have the Research Synthesis Agent bind them into one brief
Deliver the brief to the Proposal & Grant Drafter
Observe the human debate in the Colonnade—no agent may enact

quests.title: The Route Through Commerce
steps: Accept a routed task from the Routing Hall board
Consult the Collaborator Registry for an expert near the Faculty of Commerce
Carry the expert's note to the Research Synthesis Lab
Confirm completion with the Task Router

quests.title: Measure What Matters
steps: Inspect the progress orrery for a lagging outcome
Collect metric readings from the Metrics Dome
Present findings at the Outcome Wall in Charter Hall
Flag the gap for the stewards' next vote

quests.title: Guard the Reserved Powers
steps: Study the engraved reserved-powers sign in the Colonnade
Verify no agent terminal offers final vote, amend, transfer, enact, distribute or appoint
Post a confirmation token at the Routing Hall
Brief a new working group on the principle: agents operate, people govern
